components.name: Scheduler
components.description: The scheduler handles scheduling habits and tasks to your calendar.

sections.title: Protect your time
sections.description: Set up agents to protect deep work, routines, and meeting boundaries.

steps.title: Get more focus time
steps.description: Protect time for deep work and defend against meeting overload.
steps.triggerMessage: How do I set up Focus Time?

steps.title: Add Buffers between meetings
steps.description: Buffers build in travel, prep, and decompression time automatically.

steps.description: Habits keep lunch, exercise, or recurring work time consistent.
steps.triggerMessage: How do I create a Habit?

steps.description: Sync availability across calendars without sharing private details.

sections.description: Track tasks, connect your tools, and capture action items from meetings.

steps.title: Capture quick tasks
steps.description: Track quick reminders, book time for work, and log what you've done.

steps.title: Connect work tools
steps.description: Use integrations to find, manage, and schedule tasks from your existing tools.
steps.triggerMessage: How do I connect my task tools?

steps.title: Capture meeting notes and action items
steps.description: Connect Zoom meeting notes and turn action items into tasks automatically.

steps.description: Auto-sync your status and get schedule updates and conflict warnings.

steps.description: Save memories so Reclaim makes smarter recommendations for your schedule.

steps.description: Get the most value when your team schedules together.

commonData.title: Detect Event Conflicts
commonData.description: Get alerted when two or more events overlap on your calendar, so you can resolve scheduling conflicts before they cause missed meetings.

commonData.title: RSVP Reminders
commonData.description: Flag invites that still need your response and nudge you to accept, decline, or propose a new time—so organizers can plan and your calendar stays accurate.

commonData.title: Video Link Check
commonData.description: Identify meetings that are missing a conferencing link and help you fix them. Choose to auto-add video links or simply get a warning so meetings start smoothly.

commonData.title: Attendee Availability Alert
commonData.description: Get notified when a significant number of attendees decline a meeting you organized or they have a conflict that overlaps it, so you can reschedule, cancel, or find a better time.

commonData.title: Room / Resource Decline Alert
commonData.description: Get notified when a room or resource you booked declines the invitation, so you can find an alternative before your meeting.

/api/account-time-schemes.title: Working Hours
/api/account-time-schemes.description: For Tasks, Habits, and other events you want to schedule during your workday. Tasks and Habits created under Working Hours will automatically be categorized and color-coded as Solo Work.

/api/account-time-schemes.title: Meeting Hours
/api/account-time-schemes.description: For Smart Meetings, Scheduling Links, and other meetings that Reclaim schedules. Smart Meetings and Scheduling Links will automatically use Meeting Hours by default.

templates.title: Custom Work Habit
templates.description: Create any work habit — a recurring solo meeting that adjusts and changes as your schedule fills up. Reclaim will automatically reschedule it during your working hours to find the best fit.

templates.title: Custom Personal Habit
templates.description: Create any personal habit — a recurring solo meeting that adjusts and changes as your schedule fills up. Reclaim will automatically reschedule it during your personal hours to find the best fit.

templates.title: Lunch
templates.description: Give yourself a midday break to refuel and reset. Reclaim will add up to 1 hour on weekdays, flexing midday to fit your schedule.

templates.title: Morning Catch-Up
templates.description: Start your day with clarity — review email, messages, and priorities before meetings take over. Reclaim reserves up to 30 minutes each weekday morning.

templates.title: Afternoon Catch-Up
templates.description: Close loops before you log off — follow up, respond, and plan next steps. Reclaim reserves up to 30 minutes each weekday afternoon.

templates.title: Exercise
templates.description: Exercise helps boost energy and reduce stress. Reclaim reserves up to 60 minutes on weekdays, flexing around your schedule.

templates.title: Learning
templates.description: Learning is part of the job. Set aside 1 hour twice a week to build skills that benefit you and the company.

templates.title: Morning Deep Work
templates.description: Protect time for your most important work when you're at your best. Reclaim blocks focused time and flexes it around conflicts.

templates.title: Meditation
templates.description: Create space to reset attention and reduce stress with short, consistent mindfulness sessions during the week.

templates.title: Take a Walk
templates.description: A quick walk clears your head and boosts energy. Reclaim fits short walk breaks into open time on workdays.

templates.title: Weekly Planning
templates.description: Step back to plan your week: priorities, deadlines, and tradeoffs. Reclaim protects a consistent weekly planning block.

templates.title: Weekly Status Report
templates.description: Set aside time each week to synthesize progress and communicate clearly so stakeholders stay aligned and work stays unblocked.

templates.title: Metrics Review
templates.description: Maintain visibility into outcomes by reserving a focused monthly review.

templates.title: Strategic Planning
templates.description: Create space to think beyond the sprint. Reclaim protects a recurring strategic block monthly.

templates.title: Sprint Planning
templates.description: Protect time to align on scope and priorities so the sprint starts clean and execution stays focused.

templates.title: Backlog Review
templates.description: Keep the backlog actionable by regularly refining and prioritizing items.

templates.title: Product Requirements
templates.description: Block deep-focus time to define clear requirements and reduce rework downstream.

templates.title: Customer Feedback
templates.description: Stay close to the customer. Review feedback regularly so insights continuously inform decisions and prioritization.

templates.title: Customer Research
templates.description: Make space to learn directly from users and validate assumptions with regular research time.

templates.title: Coding
templates.description: Ensure consistent coding time with focus events that adjusts around meetings and interruptions.

templates.title: Code Reviews
templates.description: Keep reviews moving with short, frequent review windows.

templates.title: Product Documentation
templates.description: Block time to write and maintain docs so knowledge stays current, discoverable, and reusable.

templates.title: Project Coordination
templates.description: Reserve time for cross-functional updates, alignment, and unblocking so execution doesn't stall between meetings.

templates.title: Troubleshoot Escalations
templates.description: Protect flexible time to resolve urgent issues before they derail priorities. Reclaim adapts the block around conflicts.

templates.title: Pipeline Review
templates.description: Keep your pipeline honest with a short weekly review — update stages, next steps, and risks so you can act decisively.

templates.title: Custom Smart Meeting
templates.description: Create a recurring meeting that Reclaim helps manage — keeping it visible as busy on your calendar and resolving conflicts when they arise.

templates.title: Decompress
templates.description: Automatically add 15 minutes after long meetings (2+ hours) to decompress and reset before your next task.

templates.title: Airport Travel Time
templates.description: Add time before and after a flight to ensure stress-free travel.

templates.title: Travel Time
templates.description: Add 30-minute buffers before and after meetings with remote locations to account for commute time.

templates.title: Meeting Prep
templates.description: Block 30 minutes before large meetings you organize to review your agenda and prepare.

templates.title: Defend Meeting Overload
templates.description: Block your calendar out after a certain number of meetings each day and/or week.

templates.title: Focus Time
templates.description: Schedule focus time proactively to hit your daily or weekly goals.

templates.title: Detect Event Conflicts
templates.description: Get alerted when two or more events overlap on your calendar, so you can resolve scheduling conflicts before they cause missed meetings.

templates.title: RSVP Reminders
templates.description: Flag invites that still need your response and nudge you to accept, decline, or propose a new time—so organizers can plan and your calendar stays accurate.
templates.warningMessage: You haven't RSVP'd to this event

templates.title: Video Link Check
templates.description: Identify meetings that are missing a conferencing link and help you fix them. Choose to auto-add video links or simply get a warning so meetings start smoothly.
templates.warningMessage: This meeting is missing a video conference link

templates.title: Attendee Availability Alert
templates.description: Get notified when a significant number of attendees decline a meeting you organized or they have a conflict that overlaps it, so you can reschedule, cancel, or find a better time.

templates.title: Room / Resource Decline Alert
templates.description: Get notified when a room or resource you booked declines the invitation, so you can find an alternative before your meeting.
templates.warningMessage: A room or resource has declined this meeting
